# src

Compiled from `contracts/rules`. Change a rule there (`npm run learn -- ...`), never here.

- **invariant** `blocks/decides-which-style-controls-exist-all`: `cssPaintsWith` decides which style controls EXIST at all, so treat it as a contract rather than a helper. It answers whether anything outside `:root` reads a role, follows the `:root` alias chain (`--label-color: var(--accent)`, and a design that paints its kicker reads only the alias) and strips comments first. It is CONSERVATIVE on purpose - a rule that reads the role but matches no element in this draft still counts, because the element arrives the moment the field is added.
- **invariant** `root/keep-graphic-data-fields-plus-more`: Keep a graphic as data fields plus one or more PARALLEL state groups inside the single animation data block in the marked region - no second scene model and no parallel format. Guarding is STRUCTURAL: a transition fires only if the author drew that arrow from the current state, and there is no expression language.
- **invariant** `root/make-every-state-enterable-two-ways`: Make every state enterable two ways - by transition, animated, or by SNAP, instant, for recovery and preview without playback - and keep reset TWO operations that are never conflated: reset visual state, and reset data. Process events SERIALLY through one queue that lives INSIDE the template.
- **invariant** `root/never-let-data-update-cause-transition`: Never let a data update cause a transition: `update()` writes fields, and state changes come only from events or timers. Parameterize with DATA rather than with states - one Selected state plus a field, never four near-identical states. The default path is the ordered walk `next` follows, and `steps[i]` IS that path positionally.
- **invariant** `root/never-treat-playout-client-word-general`: Never treat a playout client as the word for a general concept: it is one TARGET among others. A slot is `logo: optional` with a default logo, never built-in. `check:client-neutral` is the gate, SPX stays the strictest one, and OGraf is the canonical interchange and playout contract.
- **invariant** `wizard/give-every-wizard-step-own-history`: Give every wizard step its own history entry at `#/new/step/<name>`, NAMED and never indexed, because import mode adds a step that shifts every later index. Step 0 carries no segment, so Back off the front page still leaves, and the open reset seeds its step from the route rather than from 0.
- **invariant** `wizard/give-kit-door-top-browse-swaps`: Give the kit ONE door, at the top of Browse: `.wz-buildmode` swaps the step body between the design grid and KitPicker. A KIT SHOWS ITS CONTENTS - every row is a card with a settled MiniPreview of the real design, its name and its graphic type, with the checkbox still carrying `data-kit-item`.
- **invariant** `wizard/keep-three-rules-svg-reader-load`: Keep three rules in the SVG reader load-bearing: a `<tspan>` is a LINE or a KERNED RUN and only the measured GAP tells them apart; hidden layers and `<defs>` or `<symbol>` text are never offered; and outline rows are RANKED by whether the shapes read as type, never filtered out.
- **invariant** `wizard/let-directions-survive-refinement-keep-current`: Let the directions SURVIVE a refinement: keep `alternatives` and `originals` as parallel arrays, replace only the selected one on refine, and offer an undo that restores the proposed design without spending a generation. Stage the pick with `stagePick` on selection AND after every refinement - chosen facets from the direction as it stands, shown from the ORIGINALS - and stage nothing for a lone result.
- **invariant** `wizard/make-mapsvgfieldsstep-mapping-step-mode-over`: Make MapSvgFieldsStep the one mapping step in `svg` mode, over text layers, pictures and OUTLINED-TEXT rows, with a ticked glyph group hidden and a placed line standing in - its box MEASURED on the step own inline render and never the preview iframe. Lead the drop step with the SVG export help ABOVE the zone: nothing below the gesture target is read.
- **invariant** `wizard/name-proven-design-result-adapted-show`: Name the PROVEN DESIGN a result was adapted from and show what it was chosen between: the design name on the card and the retrieved shortlist under it as MiniPreview cards, on the same chassis as the three directions and a Browse tile. Picking another REBUILDS on it deterministically with the same spec, no model call and no cost, and needs no structural check because every design on the shortlist satisfies the brief anchor by construction.
- **invariant** `wizard/report-what-measured-result-card-verdict`: Report what was MEASURED on the result card, not a verdict: group existing findings into the operator-facing rows and add no checks of your own, so a row can honestly read "not played, so not tested" on the one-shot path. Show verbatim any rule no row claims, never swallow it.
- **invariant** `wizard/set-aside-word-nothing-catalog-carries`: Set aside a word nothing in the catalog carries and SAY IT BACK: `browseTemplates` returns `ignored` and the count line renders it. A query made only of unreachable words still honestly returns nothing.
- **invariant** `wizard/show-money-result-card-prices-codebase`: Show NO money on the result card - prices are not in this codebase and a stale one would be believed - and print zero tokens as silence, because "0 tokens" is a measurement claim rather than the absence of one. Take cost from the telemetry ring as a median expectation before Generate, null below two matching runs, and actuals after, recorded on a RUN and never on a re-pick.
- **trap** `ai/answer-kind-question-identity-against-resolved`: Answer the KIND question by IDENTITY against the resolved chassis, and report only when BOTH sides are known.
- **trap** `ai/measure-parts-check-driving-every-text`: Measure the parts check by DRIVING every text-bearing field to a sentinel and re-reading the painted frame, never by reading the markup for field ids. Ignore opacity while doing it.
- **trap** `blocks/round-trip-colour-alpha-through-which`: Round-trip a colour WITH its alpha through `parseCssColor`/`formatCssColor`, which are ANCHORED - a shadow list is not a colour - and write it back in the form it arrived in: an opaque hex stays hex, a translucent one stays `rgba()`. `toHex` survives only because `<input type="color">` has no concept of alpha, and it must NEVER be the write path: it regex-SEARCHES for `rgba?(...)` anywhere in a value.
- **trap** `root/keep-app-declaration-matching-meta-preview`: Keep the app `color-scheme: dark` declaration and the matching meta the preview injects into its srcdoc PAIRED.
- **trap** `wizard/measure-line-room-alignment-line-own`: Measure a line's room and its alignment in the LINE's own frame, never the box's: svgAlignOf maps the plate INTO the line's system through svgLocalBox and measures there, so any surface reading the same answer has to use the same frame. And on an axis the block is CENTRED on, the gap the designer left is half the centring rather than a margin, so the margin kept there is typographic - half the drawn type sideways, half a line vertically.
- **trap** `wizard/park-graphic-whose-motion-measured-rest`: Park a graphic whose motion is MEASURED - `hasMeasuredMotion` - at rest instead of playing it, decided from the DATA and never the category. - **trap** `wizard/take-shape-size-where-painted-never`: Take a shape size from where it is PAINTED, never from its attributes: apply every transform down the ancestor chain when building the inventory.
- **trap** `wizard/use-file-chip-class-filename-never`: Use `.wz-file-chip` for a filename, never `.wz-fid`, the fixed-width field-id badge.
- **rule** `ai/let-preselect-only-require-user-choose`: Let `guessPurpose` preselect only `asset` or `mood`; require the user to choose `layout` and `plate`, whose intent cannot be inferred from pixels.
- **rule** `root/run-after-catalog-change-names-designs`: Run `npm run catalog:affected` after a catalog change. It names the designs the change can move and prints the catalog gates scoped to them, the whole catalog for anything shared.
- **rule** `templates/capture-project-brand-every-wizard-create`: Capture the project brand on every wizard Create, so graphics made in one project read as siblings. Re-apply a saved brand's palette and typeface through `brandPatch`, and judge every new category variant against its lower-third counterpart.
- **rule** `wizard/carry-what-picture-own-upload-card`: Carry WHAT A PICTURE IS FOR on its own upload card - use it as it is, make one like this, take the look and feel, make it work over this - because the purpose is a property of the PICTURE and not of the gesture. Never split it into separate drop zones. The guess preselects visibly, one click to correct, and only ever guesses mark-or-not.
- **rule** `wizard/drive-fields-step-variant-declared-capabilities`: Drive the Fields step from the variant declared CAPABILITIES: up to `maxLines` text lines, plus the logo toggle and custom upload on a `logo: optional` design. - **rule** `wizard/keep-browse-disclosure-every-width-closed`: Keep ONE Browse disclosure at every width, closed by default, carrying its active count. - **rule** `wizard/let-odd-last-entry-card-span`: Let an odd last entry card span the row through `.wz-entry-card:last-child:nth-child(odd)` and size to its OWN copy. The row-alignment reserve is two empty lines on a card that has no row-mate.
- **rule** `wizard/open-text-step-fields-already-placed`: Open the Text step with fields already placed where the artwork has an empty panel, deterministically and with no model call, ONCE and only into an empty step. Re-running is the reader explicit act, and artwork with no flat panel refuses OUT LOUD while the manual tools stand unchanged.
- **rule** `wizard/propose-brand-never-apply-strip-offers`: PROPOSE brand, never apply it: the strip offers colours read out of the first uploaded image by deterministic arithmetic with no model call, plus the install saved looks. - **rule** `wizard/state-amber-hover-every-wizard-shell`: State the amber hover for every wizard-shell control ONCE, over `.wz-header` and `.wz-dot`, never per button.
- **rule** `wizard/travel-conversation-created-project-report-talk`: Travel the conversation with the created project: report talk turns up on every change so talk added after the last result is caught, commit them at create, and persist them exactly as the spec is.
